title: Loop Engineering: From Prompts to Bounded Autonomy

questions.question: In trigger_is_due, what must a GOAL trigger receive before it wakes the loop?
options: requested=True
last_run older than interval_seconds
event_name equal to 'goal.completed'
a passing CheckResult from the previous run
questions.explanation: MANUAL and GOAL triggers return the requested flag; they do not infer readiness from elapsed time or an event name.

questions.question: Which default LoopPolicy limits are used by run_maker_checker?
options: max_rounds=3, required_passes=3, max_stalled_rounds=1
max_rounds=8, required_passes=1, max_stalled_rounds=2
max_rounds=50, required_passes=1, max_stalled_rounds=8
max_rounds=1, required_passes=8, max_stalled_rounds=2
questions.explanation: LoopPolicy defaults are eight rounds, one required consecutive pass, and two unchanged failing rounds before a stall stop.

questions.question: What artifacts does the deterministic demo produce across its three rounds?
options: implementation; implementation + acceptance; implementation + tests
implementation; implementation + tests; implementation + acceptance
implementation; implementation + tests; implementation + tests + acceptance
implementation + tests; implementation + acceptance; implementation + tests + acceptance
questions.explanation: demo_maker adds one missing item per round, so the outputs are implementation, then tests, then acceptance; the third round passes.

questions.question: When does run_maker_checker increment stalled_rounds?
options: Whenever a passing artifact remains unchanged
Whenever the timer trigger is not due
Whenever the maker changes a failing artifact
When a failing check returns the same artifact unchanged
questions.explanation: Stable passing artifacts are allowed for consecutive-pass policies; only unchanged failures increment the stall counter.

questions.question: With required_passes=4 and a maker that returns the same passing artifact, when does the loop complete?
options: After four consecutive passing checks
After one pass because the artifact did not change
Only when max_stalled_rounds is reached
Never, because unchanged output is always a stall
questions.explanation: run_maker_checker counts consecutive passes separately from stalls; four stable passing checks satisfy required_passes=4.

questions.question: What does read_round_receipts reject before returning RoundRecord values?
options: A score of 0.5 on a failed round
A JSONL file whose round numbers are not sequential
A receipt whose feedback string is empty
A passing receipt whose changed flag is false
questions.explanation: The reader requires the exact field set and round numbers 1, 2, ... in order; malformed or out-of-sequence JSONL raises ValueError.
